intro: Football and basketball are DR Congo's most popular sports.

chapters.title: Football
text: As Zaire, it was the first sub-Saharan African team at a World Cup, in 1974. It has won the Africa Cup of Nations twice. TP Mazembe have won the African Champions League five times.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: The 1974 'Rumble in the Jungle' fight between Muhammad Ali and George Foreman took place in Kinshasa.
